purpose: Human-operated, reproducible real-device scenarios; not synthetic CI speed thresholds

scenarios.precondition: Same official dataset revision, cleared local UAS dataset cache, cold request confirmed HTTP 200 (not browser disk cache)
scenarios.steps: Restart app, open globe, enable official UAS zones, wait for first Cesium postRender; repeat 5 times with identical network and build
scenarios.record: HTTP bytes/status and stages, 1256 or current actual feature count, bridge round trip, geometry fidelity, p50/p95, memory
scenarios.safety: Do not clear personal flight records; do not infer airspace completeness from a successful import

scenarios.precondition: Same official ETag and retained local dataset; confirm actual HTTP 304 rather than cached 200
scenarios.steps: Refresh the unchanged source without recreating Cesium; repeat 5 times
scenarios.record: HTTP headers/total, cache metadata handling, absence of redundant geometry upload, selection and attribution
scenarios.safety: Mark as not applicable on platforms where 304 cannot be produced

scenarios.precondition: Local UAS cache retained; app process restarted; no new HTTP observed but network state is not assumed offline
scenarios.steps: Fully restart app with previously cached UAS data, enable zones and wait for renderer-ready; five repeats
scenarios.record: Cache load, geometry check, encode, bridge, Cesium import, first postRender, feature count
scenarios.safety: No visible HTTP metrics do not prove HTTP 304 or offline mode

scenarios.precondition: Previously cached UAS snapshot with timestamp, disconnect network without altering local data
scenarios.steps: Restart app offline, open globe and enable cached overlay, repeat 5 times
scenarios.record: Offline load and local parse/bridge durations, stale-data warning, source attribution, interaction
scenarios.safety: Offline snapshots are dated and never certify current restrictions

scenarios.precondition: UAS geometry loaded and cached, camera and selections recorded in local test notes
scenarios.steps: Force a renderer document reload then wait for globe-ready and UAS restoration, repeat 10 times
scenarios.record: Renderer ready timing, resource counts, reimport count, missing data, state and input restoration
scenarios.safety: Do not mistake an intentional renderer reload for a warm no-reimport scenario

scenarios.precondition: Same location, camera altitude and orientation; terrain, buildings, vegetation, infrastructure, UAS and weather enabled
scenarios.steps: Run the same 60-second camera path in quality, balanced and performance modes, 5 passes per mode; profile only during motion
scenarios.record: Frame pacing p50/p95/max, frames over 33ms, CPU render callback p95, memory and resource counts
scenarios.safety: Never simplify or omit safety-critical geography, altitude references or source credits

scenarios.precondition: Same map layers, selected FPV simulator profile and reproducible flight/route sequence
scenarios.steps: Simulate the same 60-second path with active overlays and repeat 5 times
scenarios.record: Frame pacing and GC, CPU load, routing/input responsiveness, no duplicate objects or data downloads
scenarios.safety: Different GPU drivers and temperature conditions require separate datasets

scenarios.precondition: Known local spots and routes; globe already rendered; network state held constant
scenarios.steps: Switch globe → spots → globe → routes → globe → settings → globe, ten consecutive cycles
scenarios.record: Navigation first-frame time, WebView create/dispose counts, retained camera and data, resource/GC trends
scenarios.safety: A Flutter first-frame measurement is not the entire transition animation

scenarios.precondition: Globe ready, app suspended in background without process termination
scenarios.steps: Background for 15 seconds, restore, verify input/focus and overlays; ten cycles
scenarios.record: App lifecycle and renderer readiness, duplicated resources, subsequent frame pacing
scenarios.safety: Background residence time is not resume latency

scenarios.precondition: Application process fully stopped; same cached dataset and OS/browser build
scenarios.steps: Launch the application to first Flutter frame and globe-ready; five fully stopped process runs
scenarios.record: Dart-main to first-frame / first-globe-ready, terrain availability, OS-to-first-frame externally, RSS/GC
scenarios.safety: Dart main start timestamp omits earlier native process/engine startup

scenarios.precondition: Synthetic 10000-spot / 10000-tile SQL-pattern dataset; use a separate device snapshot for production end-to-end
scenarios.steps: Run tool/benchmark_sqlite_cache.dart --tiles=10000 --spots=10000 --runs=3; verify migration and recovery tests
scenarios.record: Legacy/bounded prune medians, spot query plan, UI response with real loaded data
scenarios.safety: SQL-pattern microbenchmark does not measure Flutter SQLite/Drift end-to-end

scenarios.precondition: Synthetic multi-polygons (1256 features) or explicit local official file, never uploaded
scenarios.steps: Run tool/benchmark_uas_memory.dart --features=1256 --runs=5; repeat --worker with same input
scenarios.record: Parse/validation/encode stages and sampled RSS; capture Dart heap/GC separately
scenarios.safety: RSS point samples are not peak heap or guaranteed memory leak evidence

scenarios.precondition: Synthetic 18000-feature bridge fixture, no real GPU or WebView
scenarios.steps: Run node tool/benchmark_globe_transfer.cjs or node tool/performance_suite.cjs --check
scenarios.record: Feature count and preservation, frame counts, compression ratio, JS parse time
scenarios.safety: CI performance durations are observational; only correctness invariants are gated

scenarios.precondition: Synthetic Cesium tileset property-write fixture, no GPU
scenarios.record: Stable writes, request counts, resource counts, camera-height crossing updates
scenarios.safety: Never present scheduling microbenchmark as device FPS or GPU memory
